title: Animal Welfare Donation Platform

requirements.text: Design and apply a warm, compassionate visual theme throughout the app — earthy tones (warm ambers, soft greens, creamy whites), friendly rounded typography, card-based layout with gentle shadows, and nature/animal-inspired accent details. Apply consistently across all pages.
acceptanceCriteria: All pages share a consistent color palette using earthy/warm tones
Typography is readable and friendly-looking
Card-based layouts are used for campaigns and donor information
No inconsistent or clashing color usage across pages

requirements.text: Implement donor registration and profile management. Donors can sign up and log in using Internet Identity. Profile includes display name, profile picture (URL), contact email, and total lifetime donations.
acceptanceCriteria: Donors can register and log in via Internet Identity
Profile page displays name, avatar, email, and total donated amount
Donors can edit their display name and contact email
Profile data is persisted in the backend

requirements.text: Implement animal welfare campaign/cause listings. Each campaign has a title, description, target animal/cause category (e.g., stray dogs, wildlife rescue, shelter cats), cover image URL, fundraising goal, amount raised, start date, end date, and active/completed status.
acceptanceCriteria: A browsable list of campaigns is shown on the home/discover page
Each campaign card shows title, category, cover image, progress bar, and amount raised vs goal
Clicking a campaign opens a detail page with full description and donation CTA
Campaigns can be filtered by category and status (active/completed)

requirements.text: Implement donation submission for campaigns. Donors can make a one-time donation of a chosen amount to any active campaign. Record each donation with donor ID, campaign ID, amount (in USD), timestamp, and a transaction reference ID. Update the campaign's total raised amount upon successful donation.
acceptanceCriteria: Donors can enter a custom donation amount and submit it on any active campaign's detail page
Donation is recorded in the backend with all required fields
Campaign's 'amount raised' is updated immediately after donation
A success confirmation is shown to the donor after donating
Anonymous (not logged in) users are prompted to log in before donating

requirements.text: Implement recurring donation support. Donors can opt into a monthly recurring donation when submitting. Recurring donations are stored with a frequency field (monthly) and a next-due date. Display active recurring donations on the donor's profile page with the option to cancel.
acceptanceCriteria: Donation form includes a toggle/checkbox for 'Make this a monthly donation'
Recurring donations are stored with frequency and next-due date
Donor profile lists active recurring donations with campaign name and amount
Donors can cancel a recurring donation from their profile

requirements.text: Implement a donation history page for logged-in donors. Display a chronological list of all past donations made by the donor, showing campaign name, amount, date, and a downloadable/viewable receipt stub with a unique transaction reference.
acceptanceCriteria: Donation history page is accessible from the donor's profile
Each entry shows campaign name, amount donated, date, and transaction reference
Entries are sorted newest-first
A 'View Receipt' action shows a receipt detail view with all donation info

requirements.text: Implement a campaign progress tracking view. Each campaign detail page shows a visual progress bar indicating percentage of fundraising goal reached, total donors count, days remaining (if end date is set), and a list of recent donors (by display name or 'Anonymous').
acceptanceCriteria: Progress bar visually fills based on amount raised / goal
Percentage, total raised, and goal amount are displayed numerically
Total donor count is shown
Days remaining is calculated and displayed for campaigns with an end date
Recent donors section lists up to 10 most recent donor names

requirements.text: Render the generated hero banner and app logo as static assets. Use 'pawfund-logo.dim_256x256.png' in the app header/navbar and 'pawfund-hero.dim_1200x400.png' on the home page above the campaign listings.
acceptanceCriteria: Logo appears in the top navigation bar on all pages
Hero banner is displayed prominently on the home/discover page
Images are loaded from frontend/public/assets/generated/

constraints: Use Internet Identity as the sole authentication mechanism — no third-party OAuth providers
All data persistence must use the Motoko backend actor — no external databases
Frontend must use React with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS only
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/hooks/ or frontend/src/components/ui
nonGoals: Real payment gateway integration (Stripe or otherwise) — donation amounts are recorded as declared values without actual money movement
Admin panel for campaign management in this iteration
Mobile app packaging (APK/Android build) — this is a web app optimized for mobile screens

required: Circular app logo with a warm amber paw print icon centered on a creamy white background, clean and friendly style (pawfund-logo.dim_256x256.png)

Wide hero banner with illustrated warm savanna/shelter scene featuring silhouettes of happy animals (dog, cat, bird) in golden hour lighting with soft green foliage, earthy amber and soft green color palette (pawfund-hero.dim_1200x400.png)
